## Language Servers

### nvim-lspconfig

+ bashls
  - Bash
  - Sh
  - Zsh
+ cssls
  - CSS
  - Sass/Scss
  - SugarSS
+ fish\_lsp
+ html
+ jsonls
+ julials
+ lua\_ls
+ marksman
+ taplo
+ ts\_ls
  - Javascript
  - Typescript
+ wgsl\_analyzer
+ yamlls
